dedupe_keys.name: companion workbook seven ways to power a data centre alberta configuration analysis

description: The workbook author publishes an editable cost-and-emissions model for seven ways to supply a proposed Alberta data centre. Zenodo provides an Excel file under CC BY 4.0. Each configuration is sized for the same stated 7,300 GWh per year of firm electricity. Four are islanded and three grid-connected; the workbook compares them under four regulatory or emissions-accounting cases. Yellow cells are documented as user-editable assumptions, with formulas recalculating the configuration results. This model can test power-supply and interconnection options for large digital loads. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this workbook. Coverage is the assumed Alberta project, not a verified live data-centre energy meter or permitted future grid connection. A limitation is that the author labels some policy cases suspended or hypothetical, so results should not be read as regulatory approval. The workbook was not downloaded and its formulas or cost anchors were not checked.
